summary: Refactor only, behaviour unchanged: the audit's large-file splits L1 to L7. Code moves out of ChatPanel.tsx, App.tsx, ChatInput.tsx, provider-registry.ts, database.ts and the mobile ThreadScreen.tsx into new modules, and two keydown chains become pure resolvers that keep their branch order.

desktop.reason: Pure moves inside src/renderer and src/main. The moved blocks are byte-identical apart from imports, and the two resolvers keep the old first-match order. No UI, shortcut or IPC behaviour changes.

reactNativeIos.reason: ThreadScreen's feed rows and StyleSheet move verbatim into ThreadFeedItems.tsx and ThreadScreen.styles.ts. JS-only change, rendering unchanged.

nativeAndroid.reason: apps/android is not touched, and it does not import any of the moved TypeScript modules.

sharedBackendApi.reason: No channel, event or wire type changes. database.ts re-exports every moved function, so every backend import path and signature is unchanged.

storageDataMigration.reason: migrate() is not touched and keeps its step order. The moved CRUD functions run the same SQL against the same schema.

updateRelease.reason: No native module, permission or version change. The mobile change is JS-only and ships on the normal OTA lane.

automated: npm run build:fast && npm run postbuild
notExercised: The mobile app was not run on a device; the feed rows are covered by the jest feed-item test only.
e2e/resize.e2e.mjs skips unless SB_RESIZE_E2E=1 and was not enabled.
